summary: Welcome to an exclusive CDAO Circle lunch which starts with a plated lunch service at 12:45pm to 13:15pm. Please click here to view the menu. Please join us for an opportunity to connect with your peers over lunch and continue the conversation from this morning’s keynote presentation. We’ll be joined by guest keynote speaker Erin Meyer for a fireside chat that will dive deeper into the practical strategies and unconventional principles behind building high-performing teams. This interactive session will expand on the insights shared in her keynote, offering a chance to explore real-world examples of fostering creativity, adaptability, and talent density within your organization.
